videos.title: Shorts URLs or IDs
videos.description: YouTube Shorts URLs, watch URLs, youtu.be links or bare 11-character video IDs.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Channel URLs or @handles. Bare channels use the Shorts tab automatically. Add /videos if you really want the long-form tab.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Hashtags to open on YouTube (with or without #), e.g. funny or #cooking.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: YouTube search queries restricted to Shorts. Great for finding outliers in a niche.

maxVideosPerSource.title: Max Shorts per channel / hashtag / search
maxVideosPerSource.description: How many Shorts to take from each channel, hashtag or search term.

maxItems.title: Max Shorts in total
maxItems.description: Hard cap on Shorts scraped and charged in this run.

outlierThreshold.title: Outlier threshold
outlierThreshold.description: A Short is flagged isOutlier when views, views/hour or views-per-subscriber are at least this many times the median of the run. 2 means twice the median.

shortsOnly.title: Keep Shorts only
shortsOnly.description: Drop long-form videos that slipped in from a search or channel tab. Explicit video URLs are still returned if nothing else qualifies.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel requests. Keep modest to stay polite.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy (datacenter) is recommended on the platform so YouTube does not return LOGIN_REQUIRED. Leave residential groups off unless a run is still blocked.

residentialFallback.title: Residential proxy fallback
residentialFallback.description: If datacenter proxy is still blocked (LOGIN_REQUIRED), retry once through residential. Recommended on the platform so daily runs stay green. Residential traffic is billed, but metadata requests are tiny.
